fluff.overview: After the Jihad stripped many elite units to fill battle armor companies, the LCAF recognized that conventional infantry remained essential for roles that battle armor could not cost-effectively fill. Mechanized wheeled platoons use wheeled APCs that offer a balance between the speed of hover transport and the protection of tracked vehicles, well-suited to operations on developed road networks. Armed with assault rifles and Gungnir heavy support gauss rifles, these platoons carry crew-served magnetic-acceleration weapons that deliver exceptional penetrating power against armored targets at long range.
